description: Source code for the AudioStreamBuilder class and related functions in the Android AAudio framework, responsible for constructing and configuring audio streams with support for MMAP and legacy paths.

classes.name: AudioStreamBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for configuring and creating audio streams with support for MMAP and legacy modes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and opens an AudioStream based on builder parameters, attempting MMAP path first, then falling back to legacy if needed.

methods.name: startUsingStream
methods.description: Increments reference count and returns raw pointer to the AudioStream for external use.

methods.name: stopUsingStream
methods.description: Decrements reference count for the given AudioStream.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates builder parameters, checking for out-of-range values and logical consistency.

methods.name: logParameters
methods.description: Logs current builder configuration for debugging purposes.
